claude_proposed_widenings.name: perform_action
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The primary mechanic is 'You can take the Dash action as a Bonus Action.' The activation cost is the Bonus Action; the result of spending it is that the Dash action is performed. No EffectAtom represents 'perform a named standard action.' grant_extra_action is semantically wrong — it grants an additional full action, whereas here the Bonus Action itself is repurposed as the Dash. A new atom such as { kind: 'perform_action'; action: StandardActionKind } (or a 'grant_action_as_bonus_action' activation-cost variant) is needed.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: You can take the Dash action as a Bonus Action.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: DiceAmount.proficiency_bonus
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The Temporary Hit Point grant is 'a number of Temporary Hit Points equal to your Proficiency Bonus.' DiceAmount has no variant expressing this. DiceExpr supports spellcastingMod and abilityModifier but not PB. UseCountCap already has { kind: 'proficiency_bonus' } for resource caps; DiceAmount needs the same. Suggested: { kind: 'proficiency_bonus' } parallel to UseCountCap.proficiency_bonus.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: you gain a number of Temporary Hit Points equal to your Proficiency Bonus
